en: Black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a French general in uniform (identified in the caption as General Pétain) receiving a large bouquet of flowers from a young Alsatian girl in traditional dress. Several officers stand around them, with a line of soldiers and a building façade with arched windows in the background. The caption is printed in both French and German at the bottom edge.
